The Australian Cyber Security Centre (ACSC) has warned of critical vulnerabilities in Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway — tools used by many organisations for remote access. If your workplace uses these products, IT staff should apply patches immediately. Separately, a new wave of scams is targeting large organisations with fake merger and acquisition offers, designed to trick staff into transferring funds or sharing sensitive information. Employees involved in finance or executive communications should be especially cautious of unexpected deal-related contact.

Australian businesses should also be aware that upcoming privacy law reforms may require changes to how personal data is collected and stored — acting now rather than waiting for the legislation to pass will reduce compliance pressure later.
